note: Gilchrist County (FL) publishes base zoning districts only as a clickable map on its zoning page (gilchrist.fl.us/zoning) and as a static Future Land Use PDF; no ArcGIS REST, WFS or bulk download of zoning polygons was found. The Property Appraiser's parcel data (Map_web, Parcel-nj layers) carries no zoning field. City of Trenton publishes its zoning atlas only as a PDF. Third-party zoning maps (Zoneomics, Mango, SmartSitePlan) are not official services.
